Eve: quick sync — I landed a prototype of hot-window speculative decode for the new 13B quantized model (q4f16).  
Eve: goal was to reduce tail latency and raise throughput for small-batch web traffic, while keeping quality regressions < 2% absolute on LAMBADA.  
Matt: nice. what perf did you see? any hallucination/quality smoke?  
Eve: microbench on p3.2xlarge (batch=4, seq=256): baseline greedy q4 = 420 tok/s, hot-window speculative (spec_window=8, fallback_threshold=0.25) = 720 tok/s (~1.71x). tail p99 latency down ~28%.  
Priya: those are promising numbers. what about eval? LAMBADA / MMLU / perplexity?  
Eve: quick holdout runs:  
Eve: - LAMBADA exact-match: baseline 65.3 -> spec 62.1 (-3.2)  
Eve: - MMLU multiclass acc: baseline 48.0 -> spec 47.3 (-0.7)  
Eve: - WikiText perplexity: baseline 12.6 -> spec 13.1 (delta +0.5)  
Kai: hmm LAMBADA drop is larger than target. is drop concentrated on long-context examples?  
Eve: early signals point to prefix-sensitive examples — when the early speculative token stream picks high-prob prefixes we never backtrack enough.  
Eve: config I used: `spec_window=8`, `spec_depth=2`, `fallback_threshold=0.25`, `early_abort_prob=0.18`.  
Matt: can you paste the smoke eval command and random seed so we can reproduce?  
Eve: `./eval/run_eval.sh --model=llama3-13b-q4 --decoding=hot-window-spec --spec_window=8 --seed=42 --dataset=lambada,wikitext,mmlu`  
Priya: two quick ideas: 1) reduce spec_window to 4 or 6 (less speculative horizon) 2) add confidence gating based on token entropy at switch points.  
Kai: also try mixing 1-pass speculative with a tiny fallback beam (beam=2 fallback) to catch catastrophic prefix errors.  
Eve: yes re-run matrix planned: spec_window {4,6,8}, early_abort {0.1,0.18,0.25}, fallback_beam {1,2} — measure LAMBADA EM and token-level KL to baseline.  
ml-ci-bot: queued job 3955550001 — run matrix (3x3x2) on perf fleet, estimated 9h. Will post artifacts when done.  
Matt: cool. also please capture token-level edits when fallback triggers so we can compute edit-distance regressions.  
Eve: adding edit traces to the eval harness. small note — quantization q4f16 seems fine for throughput but slightly amplifies the LAMBADA drop vs q8. we should add q8 runs for comparison.  
Priya: agree, include q8 baseline and q4 with calibrated per-layer scales if possible.  
Eve: next steps: 1) run matrix + q8 comparisons 2) produce short explainer doc with examples where spec fails (paste 10 worst LAMBADA cases) 3) try narrow-window + beam-fallback. will share results in this thread.  
Kai: thanks Eve. if gap persists we'll consider conservative rollout filter by endpoint (chat vs summarization) and a canary with 5% traffic.  
Eve: noted — will also add a rollout flag `spec_mode=conservative` that disables speculative for endpoints with high LM sensitivity.  
ml-ci-bot: job 3955550001 started on node p3-14xlarge-7 at 2026-03-20T13:02:00Z.  
Matt: if you need any compute reprioritization ping infra. good plan. :thumbsup:
